description: This Java class 'OrderContentWrapper' implements the 'ContentWrapper' interface to retrieve and render order content in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for caching, content retrieval, and content rendering related to order entities.

classes.name: OrderContentWrapper
classes.description: Implements content retrieval and rendering for order entities, with caching support.
